label: <DEL> step of sequences starting with 0 and ending in a/k
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (36 of 1M sequences). Fires only at the delimiter step (t == L), i.e. when the model must output the first original token, and essentially only when that first token is the digit 0 (18/19 dev activations, 99.6% of mass; one weak case with first token 1). The last original token (prev_tok) is almost always a or k (94% of mass), and L is 5-7. Second token z or 0 is over-represented among the strongest examples (top: 0 w b k r a, 0 z e a r a). Never fires in the original or copy phases. The conjunction captures nearly all mass but precision is very low (~3%): most sequences matching it do not activate, and what further determines firing/magnitude was not found (adding second-token in {z,0} raises precision to ~21% at the cost of recall).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 16 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=0 (+3.32), prev_tok=a (+2.19), prev_tok=k (+1.74), next_out=z (+1.05), next_out=0 (+1.03), orig5=a (+1.02). Lower it: in_first=0 (-1.98), in_count=1 (-1.52), recall_idx=-1 (-0.87), phase=0 & out_tok=- (-0.87).
